title: Bank OTP request
description: WhatsApp message asking you to verify an account and hand over the OTP.

extraction.message_text: Dear Customer, unusual activity was detected on your Emirates NBD account. To avoid suspension, verify your account within 24 hours. Enter the OTP we sent you at: https://enbd-secure-verify.com/login
